name: Moonblossom Garden
introDiscord:
Moonblossoms fill a carefully arranged garden beneath the kelp canopy.
Every flower seems intentionally placed. Moonblossom Mantises tend the
beds with enough precision to make simply walking through feel like a
gardening violation.
introTwitch:
Moonblossoms fill a carefully arranged garden beneath the kelp canopy.
Every flower seems intentionally placed. Moonblossom Mantises tend the
beds with enough precision to make simply walking through feel like a
gardening violation.

moonblossom-garden-approach.prompt:
Three paths wind between immaculate flowerbeds. Several Mantises watch
from the blossoms.

left.message:
One Berry sits inside a tiny flowerpot beside Shizuki's note:

'Attempted gardening.

Planted Berry.

Berry remained Berry.

Gardeners disappointed.'

right.message:
A moss-covered shrine coffer rests beneath a carefully trimmed
moonblossom arch. Inside are Star Candies arranged by size.

The Mantises have standards.

forward.message:
You accidentally brush one flower.

A Moonblossom Mantis slowly turns toward the damaged petal.

Then toward you.

Gardening court is now in session.

moonblossom-garden-depths.prompt:
Towering kelp shades three pathways lined with increasingly elaborate
flower arrangements.

left.message:
A Moonblossom Mantis trims one leaf with perfect precision.

You step on another.

The Mantis freezes.

You know exactly what you did.

right.message:
A moonblossom pool sits beneath a handwritten label:

'Gardener-approved restorative.

I THINK.

Mantis stopped glaring for six seconds.'
right.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative pool untouched. No reason to risk another
garden inspection.

forward.message:
An offering basket sits at the center of a flower pattern so perfect
you spend several minutes figuring out where you're allowed to step.

Star Candies acquired without botanical incident.

moonblossom-garden-threshold.prompt:
Living roots surround Silver Bloom Court, where three final paths cross
beneath enormous lunar flowers.

left.message:
Broad silver kelp wraps a Star Candy bundle beside a tiny garden plaque:

'PLEASE TAKE ONE.'

Shizuki added:

'Define one.'

right.message:
A Moonblossom Mantis stands motionless among the flowers.

You compliment the garden.

It still attacks.

Worth trying.

forward.message:
Restorative sap waits beside Shizuki's final gardening report:

'Plant survival rate: acceptable.
Shizuki survival rate: excellent.
Career change rejected.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the sap untouched. Gardening retirement appears to suit her.

boss-antechamber.name: Silver Bloom Court
boss-antechamber.prompt:
Every Mantis in the garden stops tending its flowers and bows toward
the central bloom.

bossPromptDiscord:
The largest moonblossom in Silver Bloom Court slowly opens.

Two blade-like arms unfold from inside.

Every smaller gardener retreats from the flowerbeds.

Apparently management has arrived.

Use /yes to enter Silver Bloom Court or /no to leave before your garden
inspection becomes official.
bossPromptTwitch:
The largest moonblossom in Silver Bloom Court slowly opens.

Two blade-like arms unfold from inside.

Every smaller gardener retreats from the flowerbeds.

Apparently management has arrived.

Use !yes to enter Silver Bloom Court or !no to leave before your garden
inspection becomes official.
bossRetreatText:
You step away from the Court. The flower closes again and the ordinary
Mantises resume gardening.

boss.revealText:
Silver petals explode outward as a massive Mantis rises from the bloom.

Lunar Petal Mantis reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Lunar Petal Mantis retreats into the flowers.

The gardeners immediately begin repairing every petal disturbed during
the battle.

You are not invited to assist."
